theme.label: Appearance
hero.title: Spot the scam before you tap.
hero.lead: Free, plain-language cybersecurity lessons, quizzes and videos for students, small businesses and everyday phone users, in English, Hausa, Igbo and Yorùbá.
hero.demoLabel: Spot the red flags in this scam message
hero.hint: Tap the four warning signs in this message.
hero.doneText: Fear, a deadline, a request for secrets and a hidden link: that’s the classic scam recipe.
flag.fear.title: Fear bait
flag.fear.text: A surprise debit makes you panic. Scammers want you to react before you think.
flag.urgency.title: Artificial deadline
flag.urgency.text: “30 minutes” is pressure. Real banks give you time and don’t threaten you by SMS.
flag.secrets.title: Asks for secrets
flag.secrets.text: No bank will ask for your OTP or BVN by message. These are keys to your money.
flag.link.title: Hidden link
flag.link.text: A shortened link hides where it really goes. Open your bank’s app instead.
home.welcomeText: A public cybersecurity awareness initiative by CloudSentinel Technologies. We explain digital safety in simple language, so everyone can protect their money, accounts and identity.
home.whyStatement: Most attacks don’t break technology. They trick people. Knowing the tricks is the strongest protection you have.
home.why1Text: Fake alerts, fake investments and stolen OTPs drain real savings. A few habits stop most of them.
home.why2Text: Your BVN, NIN, photos and accounts are valuable. Keep them in your hands.
home.why3Text: A hijacked account scams your friends next. Staying safe protects your community too.
home.threatsText: These are the threats people in Nigeria and across Africa meet most often. Tap one to learn how to handle it.
threat.phishing: Fake messages that steal passwords, OTPs and card details.
threat.scams: Fake investments, prizes, jobs and loan offers.
threat.mobile: SIM swaps, risky apps and lost phones.
threat.payments: Card, POS, transfer and ATM fraud.
home.learnText: Short lessons with real examples, practical steps and a quick quiz at the end.
home.videosText: Watch and learn. Videos play from YouTube’s privacy-enhanced player only when you choose to.
home.quizText: Take a quick mixed quiz or choose a topic. You’ll see an explanation for every answer.
home.aboutText: CloudSentinel Technologies is the organisation behind CyberAware. We build practical technology and education to help people and businesses stay safe online.
home.ctaTitle: Make safer choices, one habit at a time.
home.ctaText: Start with a lesson, take a quiz, and share what you learn with someone you care about.
about.title: About CloudSentinel Technologies
about.lead: CloudSentinel Technologies is the organisation behind CloudSentinel CyberAware, a public cybersecurity awareness and digital safety education platform.
about.mission: Our mission is to make cybersecurity understandable and useful for everyday people in Nigeria and across Africa.
about.vision: Our vision is a digital community where people, businesses and organisations use technology confidently and safely.
about.commitment: We are committed to free, accurate and respectful awareness content, with no ads and no tracking of visitors.
about.approach: We teach with plain language, real local examples and practical steps. We say clearly what we don’t know, and we show where content has not been translated yet.
about.initiatives: CloudSentinel CyberAware is our public awareness initiative. It brings lessons, quizzes, videos, tips and articles together in four languages, and works offline once installed.
about.pillar3Text: Built for people and small businesses.
team.title: Meet the CloudSentinel Team
team.lead: The professionals behind CloudSentinel Technologies, bringing expertise and dedication to every project

chat.title: Cybersecurity chatbot
chat.lead: Ask a question about scams, passwords, phishing, malware, privacy and safe internet use.
chat.limits: This chatbot gives general awareness answers from a built-in knowledge base. It is not an emergency or incident-response service. If you’ve lost money or been hacked, contact your bank, the affected service and the authorities straight away.
chat.label: Your question
chat.welcome: Hello! I’m the CyberAware assistant. Ask me about scams, phishing, passwords or safe internet use, or tap a suggestion below.
chat.hello: Hello! What would you like to know about staying safe online?
chat.noAnswer: Sorry, I don’t have a good answer for that. Try rephrasing, or pick a suggested question. You can also browse the Learn section.
chat.urgent: If this is happening right now: contact your bank (if money is involved) and the service concerned immediately. I can’t handle incidents, but the general guidance below may help.
chat.englishAnswer: No {language} answer yet, so this one is in English.
